description: The organization preserves coherence but adapts slowly when assumptions decay.
The organization balances learning responsiveness coherence and governance.
The organization explores aggressively but struggles to convert learning into coherent execution.
The organization responds to signals quickly but without governance or coherence.
The organization interprets adaptation through systems effects and decision memory.
The organization iterates operational pathways while preserving service continuity.
The organization uses scenarios and trigger conditions to revise strategy.
The organization recognizes change but remains constrained by legacy systems and commitments.
